name: Onii-chan, Asa made Zutto Gyutte Shite! Yoru Made Motto Ecchi Shite!
original_name: お兄ちゃん、朝までずっとギュッてして！ 夜までもっとエッチして！
source: Takes place following the harem route of the first game. Christmas is over, and Onii-chan and his four sisters are getting ready to welcome the new year. Together, they'll grow even closer than they were the year before.
translation: 沿着第一款游戏的后宫路线进行。圣诞节结束了，小哥哥和他的四个姐妹正准备迎接新年。在一起之后，他们的关系将会比去年更加亲密。
